 PW ICSE Class 10th Crash Course Super 60: Start Date, Features & Details
 Super 60 - Class 10th ICSE Crash Course by Physics Wallah starts on 1st December 2026. This 60-day program offers daily live classes, assignments, and test series for Class 10th ICSE Board Exams 2027. The first 2,000 enrolled students receive a free SUPER 60 Exam Kit. Divya Sharma 19 Nov, 2026 Share
 Table of Content PW ICSE Class 10th Crash Course Super 60 Overview 
 PW Super 60 Crash Course: Features and Benefits 
 Refund Policy 
 ICSE Class 10th Crash Course Super 60 is for students preparing for the ICSE Board Exams 2027. It is a 60-day program designed to help students complete the syllabus, revise important topics and practise exam-based questions. The crash course sessions will start on 1 December 2026. 
 The course includes live classes, daily assignments, chapter-wise notes and regular tests. Students will also get video solutions, doubt-solving support and guidance from teachers. The batch aims to help students prepare for their board examinations in a planned way.
   ICSE Class 10th Date Sheet 2027 has been released for students on the website. The exam will commence from February 15, and the crash course can help students to cover the last revision round before exam. 
 PW ICSE Class 10th Crash Course Super 60 Overview
 Super 60 batch will start on 1 December 2026 and continue until 31 January 2027. Classes will be held six days a week, with two lectures every day.

 PW Super 60 Crash Course: Features and Benefits
 It offers different learning resources to support students during their board exam preparation. It includes live teaching, practice questions, tests and doubt-solving facilities.
 Daily Live Classes
 Two live classes will be conducted every day, six days a week.
 Each class will be 1 hour and 45 minutes long.
 Teachers will explain important concepts from the ICSE Class 10 syllabus.
 Study Materials and PDF Notes
 Class-wise PDF notes will be available on the PW App.
 Chapter-wise handwritten notes will be provided.
 These notes will help students revise important topics before the board exams.
 Daily Assignments and Test Series
 Daily homework assignments will be provided in quiz format.
 Video solutions will be available to explain the correct answers.
 Regular tests will be conducted as per the batch planner.
 These tests will help students practise questions and check their preparation.
 Subjects Covered in Super 60
 The batch covers the following ICSE Class 10 subjects:
 Physics
 Chemistry
 Biology
 Mathematics
 English
 Computers
 History
 Geography
 Economics
 Civics
 Hindi
 Free Access to VICTORY 2027 Batch
 Students enrolled in Super 60 will get free access to the VICTORY 2027 batch for Class 10 students. 
 This will provide additional learning support for board exam preparation.
 Free SUPER 60 Exam Kit
 The first 2,000 enrolled students will receive a free SUPER 60 Exam Kit.
 The kit will be delivered to students' homes.
 It includes:
 Exam clipboard
 Exam pouch
 Pen set (5 pens)
 Diary
 Doubt-Solving Support
 Students can ask questions through the PW Doubt Engine.
 Faculty members will provide solutions within 24 hours.
 Students can also discuss their doubts with other learners through peer-to-peer discussions.
 Emotional Support and Guidance
 Students can get emotional well-being guidance from PW Prerna counsellors.
 This support is available at PW Offline centres.
 It will help students manage study-related stress during board exam preparation.
 Refund Policy
 Students should check the course terms before making a purchase. According to the given course information, purchases are strictly non-refundable.
 Therefore, students should review the course details, features and validity before enrolling in the Super 60 batch.
 PW ICSE Class 10th Crash Course Super 60 FAQs
 When will the PW ICSE Class 10th Super 60 batch start?
 The Super 60 batch will start on 1 December 2026 and end on 31 January 2027. How many subjects are covered in the Super 60 crash course?
 The course covers 11 subjects, including Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics, English, Computers, History, Geography, Economics, Civics and Hindi. Who will receive the free SUPER 60 Exam Kit?
 The first 2,000 students who enrol in the batch will receive the free exam kit at their home. How can students clear their doubts in the Super 60 batch?
